That's the product of amine (maybe an aniline) reacting with sulfonyl chloride (p-formyl phenyl sulfonyl chloride). So we will search templates that form S-N bond. Use bonds_formed: "S-N". Also functional_groups_formed: "sulfonamide". Let's try.
